Video Creator AI Free initial release.

- Instantly generates 1080p videos from 5–10 images and a logo—no editing software or timeline dragging required.
- Simple workflow: upload files, describe your video, and receive a ready-to-share MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatically manages authentication and backend GPU session setup for you.
- Supports video generation with music, text overlays, and various formats (mp4, mov, gif, mp3, etc.).
- Session tokens let you preview, iteratively edit, and export without restarting.
- 100 free credits for new users, no subscription required.
